mainEntity.name: How fast is data entry on the floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: The mobile-first interface is built to get an operator to the right project step and inputting data in ten seconds or less, using touch-and-PIN sign-in so entries are attributed without slowing anyone down.

mainEntity.name: Can it capture work when there is no Wi-Fi?
Can it model the non-weld work on our floor, or only welding?

acceptedAnswer.text: The whole floor, not just the arc. Define any operation — fit-up, cutting, assembly, inspection, any process — as a reusable work type with its own parameters and qualification rules, and it captures into the same traceable structure as your welds. So the record reflects everything that touched the part, not a welding-shaped slice of it.

mainEntity.name: How does this fit the wider platform?

acceptedAnswer.text: Capture is the front door. Elenchon is full welding management software — the captured data flows into your project structure, the WPS/WPQR/WPQ workflow, the weld traceability chain, and much more.

mainEntity.name: What is shop-floor weld data capture software?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is the app welders use to record work as it happens — which joint, which parameters, by whom, and when — so every weld is traceable back to the person and procedure behind it. Elenchon runs that capture on-premise, keeping the record on hardware you own.
